title: How Language Directions Align with Token Geometry in Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Probing study across all transformer layers of six multilingual LLMs using linear and nonlinear probes, combined with a novel Token-Language Alignment analysis, to measure how pretraining language data imbalances (e.g., English-centric vs. Chinese-inclusive corpora) structurally imprint onto the internal geometric representations of different languages (EN, ES, ZH, FR, DE).
